content.comment_body: Hi, I'm confused about the [company_name] [product_name] catalog. I need to order a module with relay outputs for 120V and a 120V AC power supply. But in the catalog (refer to [document]), section 2, pages 6 and 7, there is conflicting information. Page 6 lists: [product_name] [version_no] - [article_no] [product_name] [version_no] - [article_no] Page 7 description: [product_name] [version_no] - [article_no] [product_name] [version_no] - [article_no] The online product support references [product_name] [version_no] - [article_no] I'm really uncertain at this point. I can't verify the article number. Any help would be appreciated. Thanks so much for any advice!

Hello, Comparing to the standard version, the [article_no]-[version_no] is for the 230V variant, and [article_no]-[version_no] is for the 12/24V version. It should be similar for the Siplus variant. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience confusion due to inconsistent product details in the [company_name] [product_name] catalog, notably regarding model numbers and power specifications for various voltage versions. The differences between catalog pages and online product support create uncertainty, hindering users from confidently selecting and ordering the correct products. This inconsistency undermines trust in official documentation and complicates the purchasing process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect catalogs and documentation to be consistent and clear, so they can easily identify and order the appropriate product variant without confusion or doubt.
